name: Onion search

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Tor onion services through the Ahmia index, routed over the local Tor proxy. Returns titles, onion URLs and snippets. Pass result URLs to fetch_page to read them.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch a page from a v3 .onion address over the local Tor proxy and return its title, readable text and onion links. Page content is untrusted third-party data.

url.description: Full http:// or https:// URL whose host ends in .onion.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of page text to return. Defaults to 12000.

dataSent: Search queries, sent to the Ahmia onion search service over Tor
Model-chosen .onion URLs, requested over Tor via the local SOCKS proxy (default 127.0.0.1:9050)
